guarded.EN: I'm hurt. That's all I can say.
guarded.TL: Nasaktan ako. Iyon lang ang masasabi ko.

guarded.EN: Took some damage. I'll patch it myself, don't worry.
guarded.TL: Tinamaan ako. Ako na ang gagamot dito, huwag kang mag-alala.

guarded.EN: Bleeding a little, but I can still defend myself.
guarded.TL: Dumudugo nang kaunti, pero kaya ko pa ring lumaban.

guarded.EN: It's just a flesh wound. Keep your distance.
guarded.TL: Daplis lang ito. Lumayo ka muna.

guarded.EN: I'm wounded, but I don't need charity.
guarded.TL: May sugat ako, pero hindi ko kailangan ng awa.

guarded.EN: Hurts like hell, but I'm holding my ground.
guarded.TL: Sobrang sakit, pero hindi ako aatras.

guarded.EN: Got scraped up. Mind your own injuries.
guarded.TL: Nagasgasan lang. Asikasuhin mo ang sarili mong sugat.

guarded.EN: Don't stare at the bandages. I'm still functional.
guarded.TL: Huwag mong titigan ang benda ko. Kaya ko pang kumilos.

guarded.EN: A rough encounter, but I survived it. Back off.
guarded.TL: Medyo magulo ang engkuwentro, pero nakaligtas ako. Umatras ka.

guarded.EN: I'll manage the pain on my own, thanks.
guarded.TL: Kakayanin ko ang sakit mag-isa, salamat.

neutral.EN: A little banged up, but I'll manage.
neutral.TL: Medyo may tama ako, pero kakayanin ko.

neutral.EN: Took a hit during the last scrap. Need to bandage up.
neutral.TL: Tinamaan ako noong huling laban. Kailangan kong bendahan ito.

neutral.EN: I'm nursing a couple wounds, but nothing fatal.
neutral.TL: May iniinda akong ilang sugat, pero hindi naman nakamamatay.

neutral.EN: Hurts to move quickly, but I can still walk.
neutral.TL: Masakit kumilos nang mabilis, pero nakakalakad pa ako.

neutral.EN: Got tagged out there. Keeping an eye on the bleeding.
neutral.TL: Tinamaan ako sa labas. Binabantayan ko ang pagdurugo.

neutral.EN: Bruised and aching all over, but I'll pull through.
neutral.TL: Pasa-pasa at masakit ang buong katawan, pero makakaraos din.

neutral.EN: Scraped up pretty bad, but still on two feet.
neutral.TL: Medyo malala ang gasgas ko, pero nakatayo pa rin sa dalawang paa.

neutral.EN: Need some clean bandages soon, but I'm holding together.
neutral.TL: Kailangan ko ng malinis na benda agad, pero maayos pa naman.

neutral.EN: Took a rough fall earlier. Still feeling the sting.
neutral.TL: Medyo napasama ang bagsak ko kanina. Kumikirot pa rin.

neutral.EN: Not in peak shape right now, but I can carry on.
neutral.TL: Hindi ako nasa pinakamagandang kondisyon, pero kaya pang ituloy.

warm.EN: I took a hit, but I'm steady enough to keep going.
warm.TL: Nasaktan ako, pero kaya ko pang magpatuloy.

warm.EN: Appreciate you checking. It stings, but I'll be fine.
warm.TL: Salamat sa pag-alala. Kumikirot, pero magiging maayos din ako.

warm.EN: Got banged up a bit. Having you around makes it easier.
warm.TL: Medyo nasugatan ako. Mas gumaan ang loob ko dahil nandito ka.

warm.EN: Don't worry too much. I'll get this patched up in no time.
warm.TL: Huwag kang masyadong mag-alala. Magagamot ko rin ito agad.

warm.EN: Took a knock, but seeing you safe helps take the edge off.
warm.TL: Tinamaan ako nang bahagya, pero nakakabawas ng sakit na ligtas ka.

warm.EN: I'll pull through, friend. Thanks for watching out for me.
warm.TL: Kakayanin ko ito, kaibigan. Salamat sa pagbabantay sa akin.

warm.EN: Nothing we can't patch up together. Appreciate the concern.
warm.TL: Kaya nating gamutin ito nang magkasama. Salamat sa malasakit.

warm.EN: Just a bad scratch. I'll be back at full strength soon.
warm.TL: Malalim na gasgas lang ito. Babalik din ang buong lakas ko agad.

warm.EN: It hurts, but I know we've got each other's backs.
warm.TL: Masakit, pero alam kong nagtutulungan tayo.

warm.EN: A bit bruised, but your concern means the world to me.
warm.TL: Pasa-pasa ako, pero malaking bagay sa akin ang pag-aalala mo.

neutral.EN: I'm pretty shaken up right now.
neutral.TL: Nanginginig pa rin ako ngayon.

neutral.EN: My heart is pounding out of my chest.
neutral.TL: Napakabilis ng tibok ng puso ko sa kaba.

neutral.EN: That was way too close. Need a minute to breathe.
neutral.TL: Muntik na 'yon. Kailangan ko ng sandali para kumalma.

neutral.EN: Trying to keep my hands from shaking.
neutral.TL: Pinipigilan ko ang panginginig ng mga kamay ko.

neutral.EN: Terrified, if I'm being honest with you.
neutral.TL: Natatakot ako, kung sasabihin ko ang totoo.

neutral.EN: Felt like my heart was going to stop back there.
neutral.TL: Pakiramdam ko hihinto na ang puso ko kanina.

neutral.EN: Need to catch my breath and calm my nerves.
neutral.TL: Kailangang huminga nang malalim at pakalmahin ang sarili.

neutral.EN: Adrenaline is surging. Hard to think straight.
neutral.TL: Mataas pa ang adrenaline ko. Hirap mag-isip nang tuwid.

neutral.EN: Still feeling the panic creeping up on me.
neutral.TL: Nararamdaman ko pa rin ang takot na gumagapang sa akin.

neutral.EN: Give me a second to get my head together.
neutral.TL: Bigyan mo ako ng ilang sandali para makabawi ng katinuan.

neutral.EN: I'm tense, but I can keep going.
neutral.TL: Tensiyonado ako, pero kaya ko pa.

neutral.EN: Nerves are frayed. The tension is getting to me.
neutral.TL: Naiipit ang mga nerbyos ko. Ramdam ko ang tensiyon.

neutral.EN: Feeling the pressure constantly out here.
neutral.TL: Laging mabigat ang pakiramdam dito sa labas.

neutral.EN: On edge, jumping at every shadow.
neutral.TL: Kabado ako, nabibigla sa bawat anino.

neutral.EN: Stress is wearing me down faster than the walking.
neutral.TL: Mas nakakapagod ang stress kaysa sa mismong paglalakad.

neutral.EN: Hard to unwind when danger could be anywhere.
neutral.TL: Mahirap magrelaks kapag may panganib kahit saan.

neutral.EN: My shoulders are tight as iron from all this stress.
neutral.TL: Mabigat ang mga balikat ko sa sobrang stress.

neutral.EN: Just trying to keep my sanity intact.
neutral.TL: Pinipilit ko lang mapanatili ang katinuan ko.

neutral.EN: Every little noise has me reaching for my weapon.
neutral.TL: Bawat kaluskos napapahawak ako agad sa armas ko.

neutral.EN: It's a lot to process, but I'm holding it in.
neutral.TL: Mabigat dalhin ang lahat, pero tinitiis ko.
